admission.justification: The trace regression prevents a prior cache payload with obsolete path selection from supplying the converted-base projection used by the current comparison.

applicability: The converted-base memory projection for a legacy comparison base.
conditions: The worklist may reuse a materialized converted-base projection.
exclusions: This rule concerns the projection cache contract, independently of whether Git already holds the converted tree.
statement: A converted-base cache entry produced under the older path selection cannot supply the current projection.
